Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
Declare
 n number:=0;
 a_res_question varchar2(404);
 a_res_link varchar2(1000);
 dup_count number:=0;
 dup_found varchar2(1);
 dup_except exception;
 error_exception exception;
Begin

VALIDATE(ITEM_SCOPE);
check_package_failure;


If form_success then 
 
 IF :VALID_HH_RESOURCES.question_code is not null and :VALID_HH_RESOURCES.RESOURCE_LINK is null and :VALID_HH_RESOURCES.eff_date is null then 
 DELETE_RECORD;
 :system.message_level:=10;
 post;
 :system.message_level:=0;
 END IF;

IF :VALID_HH_RESOURCES.question_code is not null and :VALID_HH_RESOURCES.RESOURCE_LINK is not null and :VALID_HH_RESOURCES.eff_date is null then 
 show_error('16190');
 check_package_failure;
ELSE 
dup_found:=null;
first_record;
 Loop 
 n:=n+1;
 go_record(n);
 a_res_question:=:VALID_HH_RESOURCES.QUESTION_CODE;
 a_res_link:=:VALID_HH_RESOURCES.RESOURCE_LINK;
 
 --message(a_res_question||' '||a_res_link);pause;
 

 go_block('VALID_HH_RESOURCES');
 first_record;
 dup_count:=0;
 Loop
 If a_res_question=:VALID_HH_RESOURCES.QUESTION_CODE and
 a_res_link=:VALID_HH_RESOURCES.RESOURCE_LINK then 
 dup_count:=dup_count+1;
 End If;
 If :system.last_record='TRUE' then 
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 End if;
 End Loop;

 If dup_count > 1 then
 dup_found :='Y';
 raise dup_except;
 end if;
 
 go_block('VALID_HH_RESOURCES');
 go_record(n);
 If :system.last_record='TRUE' then 
 exit;
 else
 null;
 End if;
 
End Loop;


--if :system.block_status in ('INSERT','CHANGED','NEW') and dup_found is null then
 :system.message_level:=10;
 commit_form;
 show_error('9163');
 :system.message_level:=0;

 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 --end if;
END IF;

End if; -- for form success
Exception
 when dup_except then 
 show_error('16106');
 check_package_failure;
 when error_exception then 
 null;
 when others then
 If sqlerrm like 'ORA-00001%' then 
 show_error('16106');
 check_package_failure;
 Elsif sqlerrm like '%non-ORACLE%' then 
 null;
 Else
 message(sqlerrm);
 check_package_failure;
 End If;
 
End;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
dt_chk boolean;
begin
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if eff_date < trunc(:banner.hdr_date) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(:banner.hdr_date) then
 show_error('3115');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;
